remarks: Experience quality construction and carefree FIRST FLOOR living in this custom Marano-built patio home. Located in a quiet, secluded Cheektowaga neighborhood, this home offers a peaceful suburban setting with easy access to everyday conveniences. Beautiful hardwood floors welcome you into a light-filled interior, where the grand Great Room with vaulted ceiling and a gas fireplace take center stage. Overlooking the living area, the spacious 18x10 second-floor loft with walk in closet offers flexible space for work or play. The updated, eat-in kitchen has beautiful Oak cabinetry offering abundant storage, modern appliances and is open to the living space. Designed for complete single-level convenience, the main floor features a primary bedroom suite complete with attached full bathroom and walk in closet, a generously sized second bedroom, first floor laundry, and direct access to an attached 2-car garage. Say goodbye to outdoor chores with the low monthly HOA! Welcome to effortless, low-maintenance living at 25 Creek Walk! Open house Saturday October 24th 11AM-1PM. The seller reserves the right to set an offer deadline.
